input_implementation: Source/FPSGAME/FPSGAMEPlayerController.cpp, Building/VoxelBuildInput.cpp, Building/VoxelBuildTarget.cpp. Both game and build mode call RequestVillageRepair. Keyboard events are native dispatch.

controls.E: Aim at the reachable breach and request a server-side soul purchase. Intact doors use the normal door interaction.
controls.B: Open the build drawer. Village category requires the per-world village_construction plan.
controls.MouseScrollUp / MouseScrollDown: Ground placement increases or decreases yaw by one degree. On a valid socket the wheel changes orientation / connection.
controls.MiddleMouseButton: Select the aimed player-built village prefab and reuse its orientation when available.
controls.Ctrl+Z: Undo the player's latest recorded placement.
controls.F6: Open the development panel; the local authority can use its village-upgrade reset button.
